findings.summary: The prescribed run-name is unquoted, so YAML treats `#${{ ... }}` as a comment and sets the title to `Gemini review PR`, preventing dispatched runs from matching Task 21's exact title or supplying Task 23's PR number; quote the complete value.

Task 20 Step 5 modifies `.github/pull_request_template.md` without listing it as a modify target, and Task 21 creates fixture files without create targets, leaving required changes outside the typed task targets and their conformance checks.

The retrigger workflow explicitly omits contents:read while requiring checkout, so it cannot fetch a private repository with its GITHUB_TOKEN and cannot deliver the promised reruns ([checkout permissions](https://github.com/actions/checkout#recommended-permissions)).

The pull_request-only, head-branch-filtered prRuns reader excludes the existing Gemini workflow_dispatch runs on main, and Task 23 cannot associate those runs through their main branch/SHA, so dispatched reviews bypass both the in-flight hold and completion retrigger.

Ignoring completion events for superseded heads can leave the current gate green after an older Gemini verdict adds blocking findings, because Task 23 explicitly collects findings across every identity.
The prRuns result omits conclusion, so Task 22 cannot distinguish the cancelled, failure and timed_out completions required for Task 20 Step 3b's immediate terminal-failure substitution.
